entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I, uh, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I know it's been a little while, and I'm just so worried I've missed the window.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just... it's not for me. It's a bit too complicated. I tried to do the return online about a week after I got it, but the website wasn't working. I just feel so stuck.
I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return?

Yes, I went to the returns page, filled everything out, but when I hit submit, I just got a big 'website error' message. It said the system was down for maintenance or something. I was so frustrated because I couldn't print the return label.
I see. And you're saying this happened within the first 10 days of receiving the VeloBand?

Yes, it was on the 9th day. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I was worried this would happen. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back. It's just been one thing after another.
I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you being so thorough. Let me place you on a brief hold while I check our system records for that day and review the policy for your order. One moment.
Thank you for your patience. I've pulled up your account. I do see that there was a known issue that day where our return system was down for a few hours. I also checked our general policy.
It looks like you received the item 35 days ago. According to my knowledge base, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's... that's such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization for you. I am sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes. Just print it out and attach it to the box.
Wow, okay. You've really helped me out today, Isaac. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
